nogle.gloss: some, a few (plural, in positive statements)

sine.gloss: his/her/its own (plural things, pointing back to the subject)

altså.gloss: so; that is; I mean (very common filler word)

vil.gloss: want(s) to (present tense of ville); "will" only in predictions, mostly formal

kan.gloss: can, be able to (present tense of kunne)

må.gloss: may, be allowed to; must (present tense of måtte)

gider.gloss: can be bothered to (present tense of gide)

bliver.gloss: become(s), get(s); stay(s) (present tense of blive)

tror.gloss: think, believe, guess (present tense of tro)

mener.gloss: mean; be of the opinion (present tense of mene)

pyt.gloss: never mind, oh well, no matter
